caption: No separate int/float — just number. These five cover most everyday variables.
number[] (or Array<number>) is an array of any length. A tuple fixes both the length and each position's type.
Token amounts in wei routinely exceed what number can represent safely — bigint (note the trailing n) is built for exactly this.
any turns off checking entirely. unknown still forces you to narrow the type before using it — almost always the better choice.
